notes: Only es_value_r was assigned. All other fields are placeholders. Title and DOI match the supplied primary article. PDF pp. 3–4 were rendered and inspected. Preserve printed η² = .150: the source does not label this partial eta-squared, despite the requested es_type_r. No conversion or recalculation. The same test reports p < .001, not an exact p; unassigned p remains null. Distinct candidates on printed p. 227: moral-emotions interaction F(1, 54) = 5.89, p = .02, η² = .003; subgroup contrasts d = − 2.02 for OCD and d = −1.83 for controls.
